decisions.reason: The letterform-specific effect is already fully represented by the candidate's message-30 MODIFY; the broader character direction does not require another attribute.
The candidate already has a complete message-30 MODIFY for the graduated colours, while the source Event's character-direction change adds no further colour requirement.
The candidate already records the message-30 strapline colour treatment and removal of the superseded contrast options; the character-direction change adds no further presentation state.
The request concerns adding G-like character to letterforms and does not change the separate flame-based O symbol or its recognizability requirement.
The visual-style revision does not change the task-local requirement governing initial concept development and reference material.
Adding visual character to letterforms does not change the required company name, excluded word, or broader brand representation.
The source retains and visually styles the strapline but does not change the requirement to include its existing content.
The requested visual character does not alter the originality requirement or the inspiration-only role of the AI-generated draft.
The source Event changes logo styling rather than the separate deliverable requiring brand colour documentation.
Revising the logo's letterforms does not change the separate deliverable for complementary brand font guidance.
